scope: Current uncommitted carrier grouping, same-owner source-bound cache, temporary Meta transport rebinding, independent archive verifier, and targeted exporter fingerprint repair. Historical reviews and data acceptance are excluded.
conclusion: No remaining P1/P2 findings in the reviewed scope; the sole P2 is closed.

sole_finding.problem: Export-time bundle_media wiring and its _apkg call site could change Meta physical carrier addresses without changing native_host_sha256, because exporter source was outside the version fingerprint.
sole_finding.fix: native_host_sha256 now includes exporter_sha256 computed from the complete raw study_catalog_export.py source, covering both the rebinder and its call site.
sole_finding.regression: Read-only Path.read_bytes substitution removes the bundle_media call from source bytes; the repaired fingerprint must differ. No actual source file is changed.
sole_finding.accepted_tradeoff: Web-only edits to the shared exporter module conservatively trigger a new native revision.

independently_executed_checks.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='retired source|concurrent A/B|corrupt authorized|foreign bundle' tests/study_native_bundle_cache.test.cjs
independently_executed_checks.coverage: Real classic script/currentScript source ownership, shared concurrent loads, corrupt/conflicting registrations, foreign or missing members, and retired owner isolation.
Source identity/SHA race rejection, temporary Meta-only SQL rebinding, exact aggregate logical pin sets, strict sequence boundaries/order/injection rejection.
Targeted P2 regression after exporter source fingerprint repair.

other_review_evidence: Before the repair, read-only source substitution confirmed that exporter source was not read by native_host_sha256 and its fingerprint stayed unchanged. Targeted review of the repair found no new circular import or P1/P2 issue.

limits.note: Focused tests use private temporary fixtures and JSDOM. They do not establish actual full-package, GUI, mobile or runtime-speed acceptance. Parent-reported broader suites are not counted as independently executed review checks.
